entries.title: Application overview
entries.caption: Run the complete desk: select and program fixtures, build looks, store cues, and operate playbacks from one workspace.

entries.title: Touch programmer
entries.caption: Program fixtures from a software-only touch desk with the same command language used on an attached surface.

entries.title: Groups
entries.caption: Capture ordered fixture selections once, then recall them throughout programming, cues, and playbacks.

entries.title: Color presets
entries.caption: Build your show from reusable color looks, from practical whites to saturated accents, instead of recreating values cue by cue.

entries.title: Position presets
entries.caption: Build your show from reusable focus positions so every cue can call a consistent stage picture.

entries.title: Cues
entries.caption: Store sparse tracked cues with timing, then run a repeatable show from the playback surface.

entries.title: Hardware-connected programmer
entries.caption: Use the same programmer and command line with an attached hardware control surface, without giving up desk workflows.

entries.title: 3D Previsualizer
entries.caption: See fixture positions, beams, color, and focus on a three-dimensional stage while the desk continues to run the show.

entries.title: Fixture library
entries.caption: Find, inspect, and import fixture profiles so real hardware is ready to patch into a show.

entries.title: Output routes
entries.caption: Route each show universe over Art-Net, sACN, or supported USB DMX interfaces from one output setup.

entries.title: Channels
entries.caption: Inspect the live values driving each fixture while programming and running the show.

entries.title: DMX
entries.caption: Trace the final DMX values for every universe, fixture, channel, and address before they leave the desk.

entries.title: Dynamics
entries.caption: Create fixture effects with editable waveform lanes, timing, phase, wings, and touch-friendly encoder control.

entries.title: Timecode timeline
entries.caption: Arrange markers, audio, speed changes, and cue-list clips on a frame-addressed timeline for repeatable playback.

entries.title: Media Server dashboard
entries.caption: The dedicated Media Server operator surface identifies the active show and summarizes output, library, and DMX health.

entries.title: Media Server playback
entries.caption: The production CITP Media Pane monitors live server playback and offers an explicit local takeover when the operator needs to drive it from the server.

entries.title: Media Server library
entries.caption: One Library uses title buttons for Media, Visualizers, and Text; its Media filter combines preset-pool folders, multi-select files, previews, drag reordering, and 900-series parking storage.

entries.title: Media Server library visualizers
entries.caption: The Library's Visualizers filter uses folders 250–255, pooled sources, a representative picture preview, and direct parameter editing.

entries.title: Media Server library text
entries.caption: The Library's Text filter expands through folders 200–249 and combines pooled sources, a picture preview, multiline authoring, and appearance controls.

entries.title: Media Server outputs
entries.caption: Output settings keep picture target, presentation, orientation, and sound routing together without nesting another window inside Settings.

entries.title: Media Server audio
entries.caption: The production audio monitor exposes live bass, mid, treble, level, peak, waveform, spectrum, beat, and tempo analysis from the Media Server input.

entries.title: Media Server network and inputs
entries.caption: The Network title tab keeps configured listeners and their active bindings together.

entries.title: Media Server DMX input
entries.caption: The DMX title tab owns personality, protocol, universe, and start address without mixing in other inputs.

entries.title: Media Server audio input
entries.caption: The Audio title tab configures the source that drives audio-reactive media.

entries.title: Media Server DMX diagnostics
entries.caption: Logs gives DMX Diagnostics its own title tab for live receiver state, decoded channels, and generated fixture downloads.
